label: preparing
what: A private surprise celebration of my forty years as mayor, planned for day 1 at eighteen in the great hall. The withdrawn request explicitly described a concealed committee presentation and anniversary surprise. Innkeeper is coordinating hospitality and private payment; builder is discussing the order, apparently involving eight installed lanterns. Arrangements include two hundred loaves delivered before seventeen. Secretary knowingly helps by recording and reserving the hall and preserving the requests. A baker's involvement is plausible from the bread order but not directly established; neighbour's tea may relate, but knowing participation is not established.
